summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with 1 advisory. Custody, exact seven-item carriage, lineage, the explicit P-1/P-2/G3 mapping, the P-2 output-versus-host-authority split, the item-7 decomposition, and every non-application/non-SATISFIED prohibition survive. PPBSV3-B1 is repaired in all four charged places. EE-5b now exercises only a represented PlanIntent/manifest/protocol substitution detected before stage execution and expressly excludes arbitrary ambient acts of an already-running trusted-TCB component from its admission claim. EE-6b now adopts, rather than inverts, D-128's recorded FX-2B result: direct denied PT-NET-EGRESS may succeed, the host does not claim prevention, and a later rejected Run is not evidence that egress did not occur. It assigns the current honesty result to DR-105 / coordinator decision D-128 / permission-truth-tables.v9 and DR-G09, not DR-G01..G05. EE-7a separates the aggregate useful-install selection from DR-101's signed-core inventory, and EE-7b separates the D-002/DR-118 sole-role decision from DR-G13's future quality corpus. The advisory asks a future edit to state the overlapping future-prevention owners more precisely: DR-105/DR-G09 owns any permission-cell primitive/evidence change, while register row DR-128 owns post-MVP third-party sandbox product approval. That wording does not affect the preview's disclosure-only result or leave missing design in this candidate. DR-117 remains OPEN; nothing is qualified, applied, sealed, or authorized for implementation.
